title: Intel Arc Driver Timeout
shortDescription: Display recovers from a driver timeout (TDR) on Arc GPU.
fullDescription: TDR errors on Intel Arc A-series often relate to ReBAR being disabled, outdated drivers, or memory overclocks. Enabling Resizable BAR in BIOS dramatically improves stability and performance.

fixSteps.title: Enable ReBAR
fixSteps.instruction: BIOS > Advanced > PCIe > Resizable BAR Support > Enabled. Above 4G Decoding > Enabled.

fixSteps.title: Reset Arc Control overclock
fixSteps.instruction: Arc Control > Performance > Reset to defaults.

whenToCallPro: If BIOS does not expose ReBAR.

faq.a: Strongly recommended for Arc; performance suffers without it.

title: Low FPS in Older DirectX 9 Games
shortDescription: Older games perform poorly on Arc GPUs.
fullDescription: Arc's hardware lacks dedicated DX9 acceleration. Newer drivers translate via DXVK / D3D9On12 with much-improved performance.

fixSteps.title: Update to latest driver
fixSteps.instruction: Driver 31.0.101.4644 or newer for DX9 path.

fixSteps.title: Use DXVK manually
fixSteps.instruction: For unsupported titles, drop dxvk dlls into game folder.

faq.a: Unlikely; Intel relies on translation layers.

title: Arc Control Application Crashes
shortDescription: Intel Arc Control fails to launch or hangs.
fullDescription: Arc Control overlay relies on the GPU services. Corrupt installation or conflicting overlays (Discord, RTSS) can prevent it from opening.

fixSteps.title: Reinstall Arc Control
fixSteps.instruction: Apps > Uninstall Arc Control then run Driver & Support Assistant.

fixSteps.title: Disable conflicting overlays
fixSteps.instruction: Disable Discord overlay, RTSS, MSI Afterburner OSD.

videoSearchQuery: Intel Arc Control wont open fix

faq.a: Drivers work without it; only needed for OC/streaming features.

title: Arc Idles With High VRAM Clock
shortDescription: Multi-monitor setup keeps VRAM at full clock.
fullDescription: Mixed refresh rate or HDR multi-monitor setups force memory to stay at full clock, raising idle power. Match refresh rates to drop the clock.

fixSteps.title: Match refresh rates
fixSteps.instruction: Set all displays to same Hz (e.g. 60 or 120).

fixSteps.title: Toggle HDR off
fixSteps.instruction: Disable HDR if not in use.

videoSearchQuery: Intel Arc high idle power fix

faq.a: Intel has improved idle behavior in recent drivers.

title: XeSS Causes Shimmer or Ghosting
shortDescription: Image upscaling shows ghosting around moving objects.
fullDescription: Old XeSS DLLs in some games cause shimmer. Replacing the bundled DLL with the latest libxess.dll often fixes it.

fixSteps.title: Use Quality preset
fixSteps.instruction: In game graphics, set XeSS to Quality.

fixSteps.title: Update XeSS DLL
fixSteps.instruction: Download latest libxess.dll from Intel GitHub, replace in game folder.

faq.a: Most anti-cheats accept signed XeSS DLL swaps.

title: Arc GPU No POST Display
shortDescription: System boots but display stays black.
fullDescription: Arc cards require UEFI mode and do not POST on legacy CSM systems. Disable CSM and ensure UEFI boot.

fixSteps.title: Disable CSM
fixSteps.instruction: BIOS > Boot > CSM > Disabled. Save and reboot.

fixSteps.title: Update motherboard BIOS
fixSteps.instruction: Flash latest BIOS via vendor utility.

whenToCallPro: If BIOS flash needed and unfamiliar.
videoSearchQuery: Intel Arc no display fix CSM

faq.a: 10th gen Intel / Ryzen 3000+ with ReBAR and UEFI recommended.

title: Audible Coil Whine Under Load
shortDescription: High-pitched buzz from card during games.
fullDescription: Coil whine is normal in modern GPUs. Cap framerate to reduce. Some boards are worse than others.
symptoms: Buzz in menus with uncapped FPS

fixSteps.title: Cap framerate
fixSteps.instruction: Limit to monitor refresh in Arc Control or game settings.

fixSteps.title: Vsync on
fixSteps.instruction: Enable Vsync to reduce uncapped frames in menus.

title: Windows Code 43 on Arc GPU
shortDescription: Windows reports the Arc card has stopped this device.
fullDescription: Code 43 means Windows disabled the device. Usually a clean driver reinstall using DDU resolves it.

fixSteps.title: DDU clean install
fixSteps.instruction: Boot Safe Mode, run DDU, remove Intel display, install latest driver.

fixSteps.title: Reseat card
fixSteps.instruction: Power down, reseat in PCIe slot.

title: Arc GPU Hits Thermal Limit
shortDescription: GPU clocks drop due to high temperature.
fullDescription: Arc thermal limit is around 95C. Throttling at lower temps suggests dust or poor airflow. Check fan curve in Arc Control.

fixSteps.title: Custom fan curve
fixSteps.instruction: Arc Control > Performance > Fan curve, set 60% at 70C.

fixSteps.title: Clean heatsink
fixSteps.instruction: Compressed air through fans and fins.

title: Arc Control AV1 Recording Drops Frames
shortDescription: Recordings have hitches even with low CPU usage.
fullDescription: Arc Control recordings can stutter due to bitrate too low or buffer setting. Increase to 50 Mbps and use shadow mode.

fixSteps.title: Raise bitrate
fixSteps.instruction: Arc Control > Studio > Bitrate 50 Mbps AV1.

fixSteps.title: Record to NVMe
fixSteps.instruction: Set capture path to fast SSD.

videoSearchQuery: Intel Arc AV1 recording stutter fix

faq.a: OBS with AV1 encoder works equally well.
